title: Comment on C-088 "Unlock the iPhone and allow UI Automation": I didn't open the safari before.

anchor.label: Unlock the iPhone and allow UI Automation

messages.text: I didn't open the safari before.

Thanks; you did nothing wrong, and our tools did not open that page either: no log of ours has the fastwork.com/selling address.
- Likely cause (not proven): when the test tool restarted Safari after the re-plug, Safari brought back an older tab from its own history.
- Effect: with two tabs open the tool could not tell which one to drive, so the test stopped; closing the tab fixed it, and the test is restarting now.
- Long-term: int-v8 makes the test check the tab count before it starts and ask you once, clearly, if there is an extra tab.
What you need to do: nothing; leave the phone unlocked and plugged in for about an hour.
